# Anonfilly (Filly Anon)

Anonfilly is the little green embodiment of 4chan's anonymous pony fandom: usually an adult human named Anon transformed into a young female pony, often by Twilight Sparkle. The joke is the contrast between a grumpy, irreverent adult personality and an adorable filly who sometimes enjoys her new life despite herself.

[![Anonfilly in chibi style, by Scandianon](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2024/4/29/3217104/medium.png)](https://twibooru.org/3217104)

- *Appearance:* Green earth pony filly, sweeping black mane and tail, large green eyes and a dark question-mark cutie mark. Some fan versions vary her species or omit the mark.
- *Name and origin:* Anonfilly, Filly Anon, or simply Anon are fandom names derived from Anonymous, 4chan's default identity. [Equestria Daily's December 2017 history](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2017/12/the-anonfilly-wars-mlps-most-recent.html) traces the transformation premise to around 2014, although the first creator and original story remain unknown. [Flutterpriest's 2020 writing guide](https://www.fimfiction.net/blog/886885/writing-guide-anonfilly-01-23-2020) describes the evolution from reader-insert greentext to a recognizable character in her own right.
- *Continuity and voice:* A shared fan-created character template rather than an established character in Hasbro's Friendship Is Magic television continuity. No official episode, film, licensed comic appearance or voice actor was verified. She speaks in fan stories; her personality and backstory vary by author.
- *Other appearances:* She has a dedicated [Fimfiction story community](https://www.fimfiction.net/group/216551/anonfilly) and appeared as collaborative pixel art on the 2022 r/place canvas, documented in the [community atlas submission](https://www.reddit.com/r/placeAtlas2/comments/twykx4/anonfilly/).

[![Silly filly, signed artwork by Dandy](https://static.manebooru.art/img/2023/5/20/4028442/medium.jpg)](https://manebooru.art/images/4028442)

## Important moments

These are examples from independent fan stories, not television episodes or a single shared canon. Episode numbers and video timestamps are not applicable to these written works.

- *Resisting friendship school* — [Filly Anon and the School of Friendship, chapter 1 (2019), by Wind Scribe](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/445379/1/filly-anon-and-the-school-of-friendship-what-could-possibly-go-wrong/filly-anon-is-a-terrible-influence): Anon challenges Twilight's authority and resents being sent back to school while Twilight seeks a counterspell, exemplifying the adult-in-a-filly's-body premise.
- *Earning Luna's gold star* — [Princess Anon and The Fridge, chapter 1 (2021), by TheEighthDayofNight](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/487701/1/princess-anon-and-the-fridge/unspeakable-art-crimes): In this alternate continuity where Anon is a young alicorn princess, Luna rewards her humorous caricature and perseverance, showing the character's softer, creative side.
